categories.main_business_segments: CyberAgent operates four main business segments: Media & IP (including ABEMA, WINTICKET, and related content/IP businesses), Internet Advertising (digital advertising and AI-driven ad solutions), Game (development and operation of smartphone and console games), and Investment Development (corporate venture capital and fund management).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced internet technologies, AI-driven advertising and creative automation, large-scale content distribution platforms, and proprietary game development engines. It emphasizes in-house R&D, especially in AI (through its AI Lab and AI Operation Office), and robust system integration for digital media and gaming services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include advertisers (corporate clients across industries), general consumers (users of ABEMA, games, and other digital services), and venture/startup companies (for investment activities). Major end markets are the Japanese digital advertising market, mobile gaming, online media consumption, and IP/content monetization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are primarily concentrated in Japan, with over 90% of revenue from domestic customers. However, the Game segment has an increasing presence in overseas markets, particularly through global distribution of hit titles.
categories.supply_chain_position: CyberAgent operates mainly downstream, directly providing digital services, content, and advertising solutions to end-users and advertisers. In gaming, it acts as both developer and publisher, while in advertising it serves as an agency and platform operator.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include scaling ABEMA as a digital social infrastructure, strengthening original IP creation and monetization, expanding AI utilization across advertising and operations, and developing hit game titles with global appeal. R&D focuses on AI, content/IP development, and new business incubation through internal innovation programs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through advertising sales (media and agency), in-app/game purchases, subscription fees (e.g., ABEMA Premium), licensing and merchandising of IP, and investment returns from venture capital activities.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Dentsu and Hakuhodo in digital advertising, DeNA, GREE, and Bandai Namco in gaming, and other domestic/foreign digital media platforms. CyberAgent is positioned as a leading integrated internet company in Japan, with strong market share in digital advertising and a growing presence in media/IP and gaming.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended September 2025, consolidated revenue reached ¥874.0 billion (approx. $5.8 billion), with operating profit of ¥71.7 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of ¥31.7 billion. The company has achieved 28 consecutive years of revenue growth, with recent years showing double-digit top-line growth and significant profit recovery.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CyberAgent differentiates itself through its integrated digital ecosystem, combining media, advertising, and gaming with advanced AI capabilities. Its unique value lies in proprietary platforms (like ABEMA), original IP creation, rapid innovation cycles, and the ability to deliver both scale and creativity in digital engagement for consumers and advertisers.
